mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `farm_chat_session` (session_no, farm_owner_id, member_user_id, member_role, status, owner_unread_count, member_unread_count) VALUES (#{sessionNo}, #{farmOwnerId}, #{memberUserId}, #{memberRole}, #{status}, #{ownerUnreadCount}, #{memberUnreadCount})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `farm_chat_session` WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
SELECT * FROM `farm_chat_session` WHERE farm_owner_id = #{ownerId} AND member_user_id = #{memberId} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT s.id AS session_id, member.id AS peer_user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(member.nickname, ''), member.username) AS peer_name, member.avatar AS peer_avatar, LOWER(role.role_code) AS peer_role_code, s.last_message_content, s.last_message_time AS chat_time, COALESCE(s.owner_unread_count, 0) AS unread_count FROM ( SELECT fou.owner_user_id, fou.user_id AS member_user_id FROM `farm_owner_user` fou WHERE fou.owner_user_id = #{ownerId} UNION ALL SELECT fot.owner_user_id, fot.technician_user_id AS member_user_id FROM `farm_owner_technician` fot WHERE fot.owner_user_id = #{ownerId} AND fot.status = 1 ) binding INNER JOIN `user` member ON member.id = binding.member_user_id AND member.status = 1 INNER JOIN `role` role ON role.id = member.role_id AND LOWER(role.role_code) IN ('user', 'technician') LEFT JOIN `farm_chat_session` s ON s.farm_owner_id = binding.owner_user_id AND s.member_user_id = binding.member_user_id AND s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.last_message_time IS NULL, s.last_message_time DESC, member.id DESC

SELECT s.id AS session_id, owner.id AS peer_user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(owner.nickname, ''), owner.username) AS peer_name, owner.avatar AS peer_avatar, 'farm_owner' AS peer_role_code, s.last_message_content, s.last_message_time AS chat_time, COALESCE(s.member_unread_count, 0) AS unread_count FROM `farm_owner_user` binding INNER JOIN `user` owner ON owner.id = binding.owner_user_id AND owner.status = 1 INNER JOIN `role` role ON role.id = owner.role_id AND LOWER(role.role_code) = 'farm_owner' LEFT JOIN `farm_chat_session` s ON s.farm_owner_id = binding.owner_user_id AND s.member_user_id = binding.user_id AND s.status = 1 WHERE binding.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.last_message_time IS NULL, s.last_message_time DESC

SELECT s.id AS session_id, owner.id AS peer_user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(owner.nickname, ''), owner.username) AS peer_name, owner.avatar AS peer_avatar, 'farm_owner' AS peer_role_code, s.last_message_content, s.last_message_time AS chat_time, COALESCE(s.member_unread_count, 0) AS unread_count FROM `farm_owner_technician` binding INNER JOIN `user` owner ON owner.id = binding.owner_user_id AND owner.status = 1 INNER JOIN `role` role ON role.id = owner.role_id AND LOWER(role.role_code) = 'farm_owner' LEFT JOIN `farm_chat_session` s ON s.farm_owner_id = binding.owner_user_id AND s.member_user_id = binding.technician_user_id AND s.status = 1 WHERE binding.technician_user_id = #{technicianId} AND binding.status = 1 ORDER BY s.last_message_time IS NULL, s.last_message_time DESC, owner.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE `farm_chat_session` SET last_message_content = #{lastMessageContent}, last_message_time = NOW(), owner_unread_count = owner_unread_count + CASE WHEN #{senderIsOwner} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, member_unread_count = member_unread_count + CASE WHEN #{senderIsOwner} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1

UPDATE `farm_chat_session` SET owner_unread_count = CASE WHEN farm_owner_id = #{currentUserId} THEN 0 ELSE owner_unread_count END, member_unread_count = CASE WHEN member_user_id = #{currentUserId} THEN 0 ELSE member_unread_count END WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND (farm_owner_id = #{currentUserId} OR member_user_id = #{currentUserId})
